_note: Q1 (F1) — the Full Access consent dialog, plus Q5's directory-trust dialog on the way in.
Spawn shape: Sonata's production codexArgs for permissionMode 'ask-for-approval' MINUS the
`-p sonata --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` hook layer (the picker's shape does not depend on
hooks, and a hookless spawn keeps the capture free of sink-shim noise).
- `/permissions` is typed BARE. A codex slash line WITH ARGS submits as a chat prompt.
- Enter is NEVER pressed on consent row 1. Every Enter after the dialog opens is Esc instead.
- The second Enter (step that re-opens the consent) is guarded by abortOnTimeout on the
picker header, so it can never fire onto the consent dialog itself.
Run: SCRATCH=<abs scratch dir> node driver.mjs steps-q1-consent.json out-q1-consent
